claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.unlimited
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The three command words have no stated usage limit or cooldown. ActivatedAbilityMechanics requires a resource: ActivationResource, and UseCountCap has no 'unlimited' variant. Inventing a large fixed number or a 'never' cadence would be dishonest about what the SRD says.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This item also has three command words, each requiring a Magic action to use

claude_proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.no_occupants (or ActivationPredicate.no_occupants)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The third command word can only be invoked 'if no creatures are aboard.' EquipmentPredicate covers only equipment wearing/wielding/holding gates; there is no variant for item-occupancy state. This requires either a new EquipmentPredicate variant or a broader ActivationPredicate union that includes item-state conditions.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The Folding Boat folds back into a box if no creatures are aboard.
